constructions.title: Water-chemistry stations in the Belts and the Sound carrying three nutrients

n_stations.is: Distinct `ObservationsStedNr` in the water-chemistry extract whose `Lokalitetsnavn` begins with `Storebælt`, `Lillebælt` or `Øresund` and that have at least one row of each of `Nitrogen,total N`, `Ortho-phosphat-P` and `Silicium`. A station is one station number; rows are not filtered by unit, detection flag, depth or year.

n_stations_any.is: Distinct station numbers with those locality prefixes that have a row of at least one of the three parameters.

by_prefix.*.is: The stations counted in `n_stations`, split by the prefix their locality name begins with.

constructions.what: How many stations of the held water-chemistry extract, in localities named for the Belts and the Sound, carry total nitrogen, ortho-phosphate and silicon, for the triage row of the hypothesis on advected nutrients.
constructions.model: `sections()` in `scripts/pages/triage.py` streams `data/raw/oda/kemi.csv.gz` once with the `csv` reader (delimiter `;`, encoding `latin-1`), keeps the rows whose `Parameter` is one of the three and whose `Lokalitetsnavn` begins with one of the prefixes, and collects the set of parameters seen per `ObservationsStedNr`. It counts $n = \#\{s : P_s = \{TN, DIP, Si\}\}$ over those stations and stores the station numbers beside the count. It recounts only when the extract's size or modification time changes.
assumptions: A locality name beginning with `Storebælt`, `Lillebælt` or `Øresund` places the station at the Belt and Sound sections the row names; `Øresund` also matches `Øresundstragten`, the Sound's northern approach.
A station carries a parameter if any row of it is in the file, whatever its unit, censoring flag or year; the unit and censoring filters of `rescore.py` are not applied here.

justified.text: The count is made from every row of the held extract, reading only the three columns it needs, and the station numbers behind it are stored with it.
The parameter strings are the ones rescore.py uses for total N, ortho-P and silicon, written against the extract's enumeration.

gaps: A station with a single row of a parameter counts as carrying it, so the count says where the three nutrients were measured at all, not where a series long or regular enough for a co-variation test exists.
Transport through the sections is neither counted nor held.
void_if: the extract is refetched with other locality names
the prefixes or parameters in `scripts/pages/triage.py` change without the row's wording following
constructions.licenses: That the held water-chemistry extract has total nitrogen, ortho-phosphate and silicon at the counted stations in localities named for the Belts and the Sound.
constructions.not_licensed: That the series there are long or regular enough for a test, or anything about transport through the sections.
